header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.arabic_text: يارَسُولَ اللهِ كَبُرَتْ سِنِّي وَرَقَّ عَظْمِي فَدُلَّنِي عَلي عَمَلٍ يُدْخِلُنِيَ الْجَنَّةَ فَقََالَ: بَخٍ بَخٍ لَقَدْ سَاَلْتِ وَقَالَ خَيْرٌ لَّكِ مِنْ مِائَةِ بَدََنَةٍ مُقَلَّدَةٍ مُجَلَّلَةٍ تُهْدِينَهَا إِلَي بَيْتِ اللهِ تَعَالَي: وَقُولِي: لَاإِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ فَهُوَ خَيْرٌ لَّكِ مِمَّا أَطْبَقَتْ عَلَيْهِ السَّمَاءُ وَاْلاَرْضُ وَلَايُرْفَعُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِأَحَدٍ عَمَلٌ أَفْضَلُ مِمَّا رُفِعَ لَكِ إِلَّا مَنْ قَالَ مِثْلَ مَاقُلْتِ أَوْزَادَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: واسانيدهم حسنة مجمع الزوائد ١٠ /١٠٨ ورواه الحاكم. وقَالَ: قُولِي: لَا إِلهَ إِلَّا اللهُ لَا تَتْرُكُ ذَنْباً وَلَايَشْبَهُهَا عَمَلٌ. وقَالَ: هذا حديث صحيح الاسناد ووافقه الذهبي:١ /٥١٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Umm Hani (RA) says, One day when Rasulullah ﷺ passed by me, I asked, “Ya Rasulallah! I have grown old and become weak. Teach me some deed that I can do while sitting.” Rasulullah ﷺ said, “Say Subhanallah a hundred times; you will receive rewards equal to freeing a hundred slaves from the descendants of Hazrat Isma'il (AS). Say “Alhamdulillah' a hundred times; you will receive rewards equal to giving a hundred horses, saddled and bridled, to be ridden in the path of Allah Ta'ala. Say “Allahu Akbar' a hundred times; you will receive rewards equal to slaughtering a hundred camels with the Qurbani collars hung on their necks. Say “La ilaha illallah' a hundred times. Its reward will fill the space between the heaven and the earth with good deeds. Moreover, on that day no one's deed will be accepted by Allah Ta'ala except your deed and the deed of one who did as you did”. Hazrat Umm Hani (RA) says, When I asked, “Ya Rasulallah! I have grown old, my bones have become weak; teach me a deed that will make me enter Jannah,” he said, “Very good! You have asked a good question”
